The per-forward `rope_cos_sin_cache` plumbing is gone, forward_cuda rebuilds the same cache internally and calls the same `apply_flashinfer_rope_qk_inplace`. 2. `runtime/models/dits/lingbot_world.py` Same change for `LingBotWorldCausalSelfAttention` and` LingBotWorldTransformerBlock`: the `_is_cuda` branch and the duplicated `cat([cos, sin])` cache build are replaced by one class call that takes cos/sin, the existing `cos_sin_cache` and `complex_freqs`. The `AITER` branch is untouched. 3. `runtime/models/dits/causal_wanvideo.py` `CausalWanSelfAttention` gets a `RotaryEmbedding`; `complex_freqs` is built once in `CausalWanTransformer3DModel.forward` and threaded through the block as a keyword-only argument. 4. runtime/models/dits/longlive2.py Forwards `complex_freqs` through the overridden block so the `LongLive2` subclass keeps the parent's new signature. 5. runtime/models/dits/zimage.py Collapsed five `apply_qk_norm_with_optional_rope` call sites and six direct `RoPE` calls into two branches: fused QK-norm or no QK-norm goes to the class, otherwise `apply_qk_norm_with_optional_rope with` the cache it already had. `_get_rope_cache` lost its CUDA-only gate and now returns (cos_sin_cache, positions, freqs_complex) for all three groups (x / cap / unified), built once per forward by a new pure `_build_rope_cache`. 6. `runtime/models/dits/ming_image.py` Builds the same three tables via `_build_rope_cache` and passes them down. Required: Ming reuses `Z-Image's` attention but has its own forward, so without this it would reach `apply_qk_norm_with_optional_rope(cos_sin_cache=None)` and get QK-norm without `RoPE`. 7. `runtime/layers/layernorm.py, runtime/layers/elementwise.py` Fix per-frame [B, F, 1, C] modulation on NPU, which the branch hits before any `RoPE` code: the fused kernel flattens the modulation to one row, so `MulAdd.forward_npu` falls back to eager when it is wider, and the new `_expand_npu_modulation` broadcasts shift/scale to [B, L, C] instead of letting a plain multiply produce [B, F, L, C]. ## Accuracy Tests ## Speed Tests and Profiling
